Fill out insurance paperwork from hospital records
Felix Rieseberg gave Claude Cowork a folder of hospital PDFs and the insurance website so it filled out the paperwork while he fed his newborn.
·
Jan 23, 2026
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
Felix Rieseberg gave Claude Cowork a folder of hospital records as PDFs and pointed it at his insurance website. Claude then filled out the insurance paperwork on its own using the medical and legal details from the files. Rieseberg only set up the access and let it run while he fed his newborn.
How it went
The agent completed the forms successfully. The source states no specific results, time taken, or shortfalls.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
I've put hospital records (PDFs) in [folder path] and need to fill out insurance paperwork on [insurance website]. Read the records, fill in the claim forms with the correct details, and flag anything missing or unclear. Stop before submitting anything and show me everything you filled in so I can approve it.
Original source: https://x.com/felixrieseberg/status/2014490352624005458
